question: What is the meaning of details on how easily the product can be disassembled for recycling or reuse in relation to deconstructability?
data_point: details on how easily the product can be disassembled for recycling or reuse
description: The details on how easily the product can be disassembled for recycling or reuse in relation to deconstructability refer to the ability of the product to be taken apart in a way that allows some parts to be either reused or recycled. This aspect is crucial for achieving the highest possible level of reused and recycled content from end-of-life products, contributing to the conservation of natural resources and enabling the closing of material loops.
